sheets.name: Moon Water Palace — arcade, portal, corner and ghat sections
Moon Water Palace — dome and minaret sections
Moon Water Palace — architectural detail kit

B02-STRUCT-001: Four labelled groups and their main/front/plan/side views are present. Arcade and corner arches visibly open; portal lower passage remains clear. Pearl/ivory hosts, gold mouldings and pale blue/amber accents derive from GEN-05, with extra resolved ornament proposed.

All metrics and hidden depth are working proposals. The depicted stairs do not prove eight identical risers;1.2m is the stair floor rise, excluding raised cheek/parapet ornament. Cornices, pier caps and inset elevations are not identical measured projections.

A repeated arcade must share one boundary pier, avoiding doubled columns or overlapping floors. Model the shell and cut openings first; retain trims as removable groups. Arcade roof/depth closure, exact L-corner footprint, stairs and hall rear joins require model review.
B02-ROOF-001: Four labelled roof/tower sections are present: pearl onion shell, drum ring, repeat shaft and open crown. Main dome has a hollow underside and tip socket; crown shows open column-supported lantern. Revision removes opaque drum window infill and apparent cap.

Eighteen-metre dome/drum interfaces and2.8m shaft/crown interfaces match numerically. They are proposed nominal dimensions, not evaluated mesh diameters. Crown brackets, dome wall thickness, lantern interior and circular seam profiles are not verified.

Small front/side/underside/section insets are explanatory drawings, not true projections of one model. Drum window sizes differ visually from the standalone D09 proposal; reconcile aperture and insert together. Main roof fringe and drum crown need one shared seat detail so stacked decorative rims do not collide.
B02-DETAIL-001: Twelve labelled main groups appear in4columns by3rows. Revision removes rail end posts, removes the tiny dome under D10 and changes D08 rear view to a lotus silhouette. These improve part separation, without proving exact view parity.

D01 lattice remains an intricate illustrative pattern, not a validated seamless repeat. D08 front/back petals remain approximate; reconstruct a single outline for the actual mesh. Small D10 socket insets also need parity review.

D03 is a smaller cusped surround proposal, not a proven fit to the large arcade opening. D02 and D09 glazing must be resized from locked host apertures; maintain lower portal passage. D04/D05 and D06/D07 profile joins, D12 curvature, repeat motifs and attachment surfaces remain unverified.
